name: pets-showcase
description: Pet program Stage P5 showcase — a pet-ready 4-room HDB flat. On top of the default furnished flat we add SG-compliance fittings + pet furniture: a CMF safety mesh screen snapped onto EVERY window (aperture-safe, internal mount), a pet gate spanning the kitchen/service-yard doorway, a cat wall run (shelf + steps + bridge) + a cat tree on a living-room wall, a litter cabinet in the service yard, and a dog bed + raised feeding station. Screenshots: living room with cat run + tree, the kitchen doorway with the gate, the service yard with the litter cabinet, and a whole-flat orbit wide.

steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: inject-pet-fittings
assert-placed
steps.eval: (function(){ const ids = window.__store.getState().items.map(i => i.id); const need = ['cat-tree-show','cat-wall-shelf-show','litter-cabinet-show','feeder-show']; for (const n of need) if (!ids.includes(n)) throw new Error('missing ' + n); const meshCount = ids.filter(i => i.startsWith('mesh-')).length; if (meshCount < 1) throw new Error('no mesh screens placed'); console.log('pet fittings placed: ' + meshCount + ' mesh screens, gate=' + ids.some(i => i.startsWith('gate-'))); })()
